label: GO step after a rewarded trial, committed to a2, early/mid episode (trials < 50)
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass; never at D1 or D2) and only when the previous trial was rewarded (in_rew=0 at GO but prev_reward==1 holds for all mass). It fires almost only when the agent is about to choose a2: 99.5% of mass has action==2 and model_act==2, and 80% of mass sits in the most negative choice-logit bin (choice < -8.9). Uses no future variables: choice is the agent own policy logit computed at this step. There is a strong episode-time dependence: rate is 5-7% for trials 0-49 and roughly zero after trial 50, so precision depends on an ep_trial<50 cutoff (likely a slow hidden-state drift over the episode, not a task variable). Value-head output in [7.73, 8.10) also captures 96% of mass, consistent with this. Without the time cutoff, GO & prev_reward==1 & a2 has recall 0.98 but precision 0.25. Remaining false positives are often the first rewarded a2 trial after an unrewarded or a1 trial; requiring a longer reward streak raised precision but lost too much recall. It does not fire for a1 choices, after unrewarded trials, or late in the episode. Magnitude was not systematically checked; top examples are often the first GO of the window, and activation sometimes decays across consecutive rewarded a2 trials. Dev: P 0.64, R 0.96, F1 0.77, mass recall 0.98.
